app.title: Pawnpal
setup.heading: Let's play chess!
setup.level.1.name: Sleepy Snail
setup.level.1.description: Plenty of chances to practice your first moves.
setup.level.2.name: Curious Kitten
setup.level.2.description: Likes to grab pieces and sometimes forgets to guard its own.
setup.level.3.name: Busy Beaver
setup.level.3.description: Keeps its pieces busy and spots a quick checkmate.
setup.level.4.name: Clever Fox
setup.level.4.description: Looks for tricks when you leave a piece undefended.
setup.level.5.name: Wise Owl
setup.level.5.description: Plans ahead and spots many of your tricks.
setup.level.6.name: Brave Bear
setup.level.6.description: Attacks boldly and gives you fewer chances to recover.
setup.level.7.name: Mighty Lion
setup.level.7.description: Sees tricky threats and keeps the pressure on.
setup.level.8.name: Dragon
setup.level.8.description: Our toughest opponent. Take your time and look ahead.
